_readme: Exposure decisions for the tool parity audit (scripts/tool-parity.mjs). Every tool visible on the MCP bridge or playground agent must be recorded here as 'gap' (absence is a defect to fix) or 'deliberate' (absence is design, with the reason). Unannotated tools fail `bun run tool:parity --check`.
